library(Seurat)
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)

params

# Match P. trichocarpa vs P. tremula gene ID

```{r}
ptr_matches <- read.table(params$path_diamond_output)
colnames(ptr_matches) <- c(
    "Query_accession",
    "Target_accession",
    "Sequence_identity",
    "Length",
    "Mismatches",
    "Gap_openings",
    "Query_start",
    "Query_end",
    "Target_start",
    "Target_end",
    "E_value",
    "Bit_score"
)
dim(ptr_matches); head(ptr_matches)
```

Filter match results

```{r}
ptr_best_matches <- ptr_matches %>% 
  arrange(Query_accession, desc(Sequence_identity)) %>%
  distinct(Query_accession, .keep_all = TRUE)
dim(ptr_best_matches)

# 
ptr_rbest_matches <- ptr_best_matches %>% 
  arrange(Target_accession, desc(Sequence_identity)) %>%
  distinct(Target_accession, .keep_all = TRUE)
dim(ptr_rbest_matches)

# show result
head(ptr_rbest_matches)
```

Show the distribution of sequence similarity

```{r}
ptr_rbest_matches %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = Sequence_identity)) + 
    geom_histogram(binwidth=.5) +
    theme_classic() + 
    labs(title = "
Sequence similarity
of P. trichocarpa & P. tremula reciprocal best-hits
    ")
```

```{r}
ptr_rbest_matches_90 <- subset(ptr_rbest_matches, ptr_rbest_matches$Sequence_identity > 90)
ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession %<>% sapply(function(x){sub("[0-9]*[.]p", "v4.1", x)})
ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession %<>% sapply(function(x){sub("[.][0-9]*[.]p", "", x)})
tremula_2_trichocarpa <- as.vector(ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession)
names(tremula_2_trichocarpa) <- ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession
head(ptr_rbest_matches_90)
```

# Pseudobulk expression

Sum **raw RNA counts**, never integrated, scaled or log-normalized expression.
Each column represents one biological sample in one matched state.

```{r pseudobulk}
# sc data
seurat_obj_sc <- readRDS(params$inputs[[1]]$rds)
seurat_obj_sc <- subset(
  seurat_obj_sc, 
  cells = seurat_obj_sc@meta.data %>% 
    filter(
      !is.na(cell_label),
      !cell_label %in%  c("Outlier1", "Outlier2")
    ) %>% row.names
)
table(seurat_obj_sc$orig.ident, seurat_obj_sc$cell_label)
pb_sc <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj_sc,
  group.by = c("orig.ident", "cell_label"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA

# sn data 1
seurat_obj_sn <- readRDS(params$inputs[[2]]$rds)
DimPlot(seurat_obj_sn, label = TRUE)
seurat_obj_sn$batch_suffix <- Cells(seurat_obj_sn) %>% sapply(function(x){strsplit(x, "_")[[1]][4]})
table(seurat_obj_sn$batch_suffix, seurat_obj_sn$treat)
seurat_obj_sn <- subset(seurat_obj_sn, treat == "Control") # exclude drought treatment cells
seurat_obj_sn <- subset(seurat_obj_sn, seurat_clusters %in% c(0, 3, 7, 13)) # (6, 19, 22 = mature xylem)
table(seurat_obj_sn$batch_suffix, seurat_obj_sn$seurat_clusters)
pb_sn <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj_sn, 
  group.by = c("batch_suffix", "seurat_clusters"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA
rownames(pb_sn) <- tremula_2_trichocarpa[rownames(pb_sn)]

# sn data 2
seurat_obj_sn2 <- readRDS(params$inputs[[3]]$rds)
DimPlot(seurat_obj_sn2, label = TRUE)
seurat_obj_sn2$batch_suffix <- sapply(Cells(seurat_obj_sn2), function(x){strsplit(x, "_")[[1]][2]})
seurat_obj_sn2 <- subset(seurat_obj_sn2, seurat_clusters %in% c(8, 9, 14, 16, 19, 21, 23, 32))
seurat_obj_sn2 <- subset(seurat_obj_sn2, treat == "Nuclei")
table(seurat_obj_sn2$batch_suffix, seurat_obj_sn2$treat)
pb_sn2 <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj_sn2,
  group.by = c("batch_suffix", "seurat_clusters"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA
rownames(pb_sn2) <- tremula_2_trichocarpa[rownames(pb_sn2)]

# st data
input_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(params$inputs[[4]]$rds, envir = input_env)
seurat_obj_st <- input_env$stall_fin
rm(input_env)
pb_st <- AggregateExpression(
  subset(seurat_obj_st, celltype2 %in% c("XRP_2", "XRP_3", "XRP_1", "RIC_2", "XMC", "XPC", "RIC_1", "FIC")),
  group.by = c("orig.ident", "celltype2"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA
```

```{r}
features_all <- row.names(pb_sc) %>%
  intersect(row.names(pb_sn)) %>% 
  intersect(row.names(pb_sn2)) %>%
  intersect(row.names(pb_st))

source("notebooks/scripts/hourglass_analysis.R")
sim <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_sc[features_all, ], pb_sn[features_all,], "Jensen-Shannon"
)
pheatmap(sim)

sim <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_sc[features_all, ], pb_sn2[features_all,], "Jensen-Shannon"
)
pheatmap(sim)

sim <- calculate_similarity(
  pb_sc[features_all, ], pb_st[features_all,], "Jensen-Shannon"
)
pheatmap(sim)
```

Aggregate pseudobulk matrices

```{r}
pb_sc <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj_sc,
  group.by = c("orig.ident"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA

# sn data 1
pb_sn <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj_sn, 
  group.by = c("batch_suffix"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA
colnames(pb_sn) <- paste("PMID41013691_", colnames(pb_sn))
rownames(pb_sn) <- tremula_2_trichocarpa[rownames(pb_sn)]

# sn data 2
pb_sn2 <- AggregateExpression(
  seurat_obj_sn2,
  group.by = c("batch_suffix"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA
colnames(pb_sn2) <- paste("PMID40877938_", colnames(pb_sn2))
rownames(pb_sn2) <- tremula_2_trichocarpa[rownames(pb_sn2)]

# st data
pb_st <- AggregateExpression(
  subset(seurat_obj_st, celltype2 %in% c("XRP_2", "XRP_3", "XRP_1", "RIC_2", "XMC", "XPC", "RIC_1", "FIC")),
  group.by = c("orig.ident"),
  features = ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession,
  assays = "RNA"
)$RNA
```

Aggregate counts

```{r}
features_all <- row.names(pb_sc) %>%
  intersect(row.names(pb_sn)) %>% 
  intersect(row.names(pb_sn2)) %>%
  intersect(row.names(pb_st))

pb_all <- pb_sc[features_all, ] %>%
  cbind(pb_st[features_all, ]) %>%
  cbind(pb_sn[features_all, ]) %>%
  cbind(pb_sn2[features_all, ])
```

Create metadata

```{r}
coldata <- data.frame(
  technology = c(
    rep("sc", ncol(pb_sc)),
    rep("sp", ncol(pb_st)),
    rep("sn", ncol(pb_sn)),
    rep("sn", ncol(pb_sn2))
  )
) %>% mutate(
  protoplasting = case_match(
    technology,
    "sc" ~ "protoplasting",
    "sn" ~ "no_protoplasting",
    "sp" ~ "no_protoplasting"
  ),
  cell_level = case_match(
    technology,
    "sc" ~ "cell",
    "sn" ~ "cell",
    "sp" ~ "pseudocell"
  )
)
row.names(coldata) <- c(
  colnames(pb_sc),
  colnames(pb_st),
  colnames(pb_sn),
  colnames(pb_sn2)
)
coldata
```

# Differential expression

```{r differential-expression}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = pb_all[, coldata %>% subset(technology != "sp") %>% rownames],
  colData = coldata %>% subset(technology != "sp"),
  design = ~ protoplasting
)
dds$protoplasting <- relevel(dds$protoplasting, ref = "no_protoplasting")

dds2 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = pb_all[, coldata %>% subset(technology != "sn") %>% rownames],
  colData = coldata %>% subset(technology != "sn"),
  design = ~ protoplasting
)
dds2$protoplasting <- relevel(dds2$protoplasting, ref = "no_protoplasting")
```


```{r differential-expression}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
dds2 <- DESeq(dds2)
res <- results(dds)
res2 <- results(dds2)
res; res2
```

```{r}
data_plot <- as.data.frame(res)
data_plot %<>% mutate(
  group = ifelse(
    padj > 0.05, "not-sig", ifelse(
      log2FoldChange > 1.5, "up-reg", ifelse(
        log2FoldChange < -1.5, "down-reg", "sig-not"
      )
    )
  )
)
p_vol_scsn <- ggplot(
  data_plot,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = group)
) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("up-reg" = "salmon", "down-reg" = "lightgreen", "not-sig" = "grey40", "sig-not" = "grey40")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "sc vs sn"
  )
p_vol_scsn
```


```{r}
data_plot <- as.data.frame(res2)
data_plot %<>% mutate(
  group = ifelse(
    padj > 0.05, "not-sig", ifelse(
      log2FoldChange > 1.5, "up-reg", ifelse(
        log2FoldChange < -1.5, "down-reg", "sig-not"
      )
    )
  )
)
p_vol_scsp <- ggplot(
  data_plot,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = group)
) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("up-reg" = "salmon", "down-reg" = "lightgreen", "not-sig" = "grey40", "sig-not" = "grey40")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
  labs(
    title = "sc vs sp"
  )
  
p_vol_scsp
```

```{r}
deg_scsn <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  filter(
    log2FoldChange > 1.5,
    padj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    padj
  )
deg_scsp <- as.data.frame(res2) %>%
  filter(
    log2FoldChange > 1.5,
    padj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    padj
  )

head(deg_scsn); head(deg_scsp)
```


```{r}
if (!require("VennDiagram", character.only = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("VennDiagram")
  library(VennDiagram, character.only = TRUE)
}

library(RColorBrewer)
myCol <- brewer.pal(2, "Pastel2")[1:2]

# Chart
venn.diagram(
  x = list(rownames(deg_scsn), rownames(deg_scsp)),
  category.names = c("SC vs SN" , "SC vs SP"),
  filename = file.path(params$outdir, 'Protoplasting_induced.png'),
  output=TRUE,
  
  # Output features
  imagetype="png" ,
  height = 480 , 
  width = 520 , 
  resolution = 300,
  compression = "lzw",
  
  # Circles
  lwd = 2,
  lty = "blank",
  fill = myCol,
  
  # Numbers
  cex = .6,
  fontface = "bold",
  fontfamily = "sans",
  
  # Set names
  cat.cex = 0.6,
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.default.pos = "outer",
  cat.pos = c(-27, 27),
  cat.dist = c(0.055, 0.055),
  cat.fontfamily = "sans",
  
  rotation.degree = 0
)
```


```{r, echo=FALSE}
res_all <- full_join(
  as.data.frame(res) %>% mutate(gene = res@rownames), 
  as.data.frame(res2) %>% mutate(gene = res@rownames),
  by = "gene",
  suffix = c(".sn", ".sp")
)

# append Arabidopsis best-hit
annot_info <- read.csv(params$path_annot_info, sep = "\t")
arab_best_hit <- annot_info$best_arabi_gene
arab_defline <- annot_info$best_arabi_defline
names(arab_best_hit) <- annot_info$locusName %>% paste0(".v4.1")
names(arab_defline) <- annot_info$locusName %>% paste0(".v4.1")
res_all$arab_best_hit <- arab_best_hit[res_all$gene]
res_all$arab_defline <- arab_defline[res_all$gene]

# write data
dir.create(params$outdir)
write.csv(res_all, file.path(params$outdir, "dea_all.csv"))
```
